description: Toyota's Bridge specialist for notes: writes a fresh diagnostic marker to its own Notes diagnostic note (read back, sent after a yes), checks where the marker shows (store, endpoint), or clears the diagnostic note
notes: Toyota's profile maps this name to adapters/bridge_specialist_runner.BridgeSpecialistRunner. The model only picks the operation; bridge_client/specialists.NotesBuilder makes the marker and the exact JSON prompt. Writes and clears are read back and sent only after a yes.
